description: What a buy or a sell of a Robinhood Chain token would give right now through The Desk's router: expected amount, price impact, the Desk fee and the token's Risk Level. Nothing is prepared or sent. Buys spend the pool's quote asset (ETH for most tokens, USDG for some); sells give it back.

unit.description: buy: "quote" (ETH/USDG, default) or "usd"; sell: "token" (default), "usd" or "percent" (needs wallet)

wallet.description: the wallet that would trade (needed for percent)

name: quote_trade
title: Quote a buy or a sell on the Desk
